name: notifygram
description: Lightweight Node.js library for sending application notifications to a Telegram channel
author: Igor K <igorfordev@gmail.com>

scripts.test:runtime: node -e "delete process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN; delete process.env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID; import('./dist/index.js').then(({ createNotifygram }) => { const notifygram = createNotifygram({ token: '123456:test-token', chatId: -1001234567890, meta: { hostname: false, timeStamp: false } }); if (typeof notifygram.flush !== 'function') process.exit(1); })"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && npm run test:runtime
